newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ Nov futures end up, off highs as trade sells.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ Nov futures end up, off highs as trade sells.

text.p: NYCE November frozen concentrated orange juice closed firmer but off the highs as fund buying dried up and trade selling accelerated in late session dealings, floor sources said.
November closed at 113.70, up 0.80, having ranged from 114.20 to 112.00. The back months finished 0.20 to 0.70 lower.

Market sources said the November contract could continue to climb higher on options-related fund buying. Kevin Marshburn, an analyst with Fimat Futures, pegged nearby resistance in November at 115.00, a heavily-traded strike price.
"The move we're seeing now in November is more options-releated," Marshburn said.
The last trading day for November FCOJ options is Friday, October 4.

Prices are not likely to make a major breakout ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's Florida crop estimate released October 11, however. Expectations are for increased production and inventories in 1996/97 from year-ago levels.
